title: Lovely Citrusy Egyptian Eggplant Gratin
description: A show-stopping Egyptian dish featuring roasted eggplant, citrusy flavors, and a cheese pull, perfect for a special occasion. This vegetarian-friendly gratin is made with ground clove and deglazed fond for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the eggplant slices with olive oil, ground clove, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and orange juice.
In a separate bowl, combine grated mozzarella cheese and grated parmesan cheese.
In a ramekin, create a layer of roasted eggplant slices, followed by a drizzle of the citrus juice mixture and a sprinkle of the cheese mixture.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Deglaze the fond from the baking sheet with a little bit of water and pour it over the top layer of cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the gratin from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
